description: This header file declares a wrapper interface 'WrapsImpl' with virtual functions for system calls and related functionality, along with a singleton class 'Wraps' that provides static access to these functions, serving as an abstraction layer for system interactions.

classes.name: WrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class defining virtual methods for system-related functions, intended to be implemented for mocking or custom behavior.

classes.name: Wraps
classes.description: Singleton class providing static methods to access system functions through an implementation of WrapsImpl.

methods.name: Wraps
methods.description: Default constructor for the Wraps singleton class.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance of WrapsImpl used by Wraps.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Wraps.

methods.name: popen
methods.description: Opens a process by creating a pipe, for reading or writing.

methods.name: pclose
methods.description: Closes a pipe opened by popen.

methods.name: syslog
methods.description: Logs messages to the system logger.

methods.name: getmntent
methods.description: Reads next entry from a mount table.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: A variadic version of secure popen functionality.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Closes a stream opened with v_secure_popen.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Executes a system command with variadic arguments.

methods.name: readlink
methods.description: Reads value of a symbolic link.
